title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: In how many ways can the letters in BEEKEEPER be rearranged so that two or more E’s do not appear together?

solutions.text:
The word has \(5\) E’s and \(4\) other letters: B, K, P, and R. To keep no two E’s adjacent, the only possible pattern is \[ E\_E\_E\_E\_E, \] with the four non-E letters in the four gaps.

The letters B, K, P, and R can be arranged in those gaps in \(4!=24\) ways.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: There are \(5\) E’s and \(4\) other letters
The four non-E letters must fill the four gaps between the E’s
